meta.title: Paiger · The pager is now their phone
meta.description: Paiger replaces restaurant buzzers with the customer's own phone. Scan a QR code, take a seat, and get rung when the order is ready. No app, no hardware.
hero.title: The pager is now their phone.
hero.sub: Customers scan a QR code at the counter and take a seat. When the order is ready, Paiger rings their phone, even when it’s locked in their pocket. No app to download, no buzzers to buy or lose.
hero.note: Set up in minutes on the iPad you already have.
demo.idle: Issue a pager on the iPad. It appears here after the customer scans.
demo.h1: Type an order number, then tap Issue pager.
demo.h2: The customer scanned. Now tap Order ready.
demo.h3: Their phone is ringing. This is what happens in their pocket.
strip.1: Opens instantly on iPhone, no download
how.title: Three taps between the counter and the pickup.
how.1p: The cashier enters the number on the iPad. A QR code appears on screen, or on the printed receipt.
how.2t: The customer scans and sits down
how.2p: Their camera opens your branded page with the order number and a live status. Nothing to install.
how.3p: One tap sends the alert. The cashier screen shows who is on the way, so the counter stays clear.
feat.title: Everything a buzzer did, without the buzzer.
feat.heroT: It reaches them on the lock screen.
feat.heroP: On iPhone, the order shows up as a live card on the lock screen and rings when it’s ready. Customers can step outside, take a call, or browse other shops nearby.
feat.1t: A cashier screen made for the iPad
feat.1p: Big keypad, live order board, and one-tap ready. Staff learn it in a minute.
feat.2p: Customers see your name, colour and logo on the order page and the lock screen.
feat.3p: See orders per day, average wait, and your busiest hours.
feat.4p: Each customer sees the page in their phone’s language, right to left when needed.
feat.5p: Customers tap once when they head to the counter, and your screen shows it.

faq.title: Questions owners ask us.
faq.q1: Do my customers need to download an app?
faq.a1: No. On iPhone the order opens instantly from the camera as a lightweight App Clip. On Android it opens in the browser.
faq.q2: Will it ring if their phone is locked?
faq.a2: Yes. On iPhone the order lives on the lock screen and rings when you tap ready. On Android, customers allow alerts once when they open the page.
faq.q3: What do I need to start?
faq.a3: An iPad, tablet or computer with a browser, and internet. Sign up, add your logo, and open the cashier screen.
faq.q4: How does pay per order work?
faq.a4: Each order you page uses one point. Buy points in advance and we’ll alert you before they run out, or choose to be billed for your usage at the end of the month.
faq.q5: What happens after the free trial?
faq.a5: After 3 days, pick a plan to keep paging. Your settings and order history stay where they are.
final.title: Put the buzzers in a drawer.
final.sub: Your first 3 days are on us.
